claim: The motivic exponential Galois group G_M is the Tannakian group of <M>^tensor, sitting in GL(R_B(M)).
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives (book), Prop. 1.3.1; Intro section 1.3.

claim: Exponential period conjecture: for M over a number field, trdeg_Q<periods of M> = dim G_M.
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, Conjecture 1.3.2 (cf. Conj. 8.2.6; pdf p.17).

claim: dim G_M is always an unconditional UPPER BOUND for the transcendence degree; equality is the conjecture.
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, Conjecture 1.3.2 surrounding text; Intro section 1.3.

claim: Rapid-decay homology H_n^rd(X,f) = lim_{r->inf} H_n(X(C), f^{-1}(S_r); Q); finite-dimensional and dual to de Rham.
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, Definition 3.1.1.1 (pdf p.91); finiteness section 3.1.2 (pdf p.92).

claim: Period pairing [omega]x[gamma] -> integral_gamma e^{-f} omega; FJ sign convention is e^{-f} (so V_quad's e^{+xi} means f_FJ = -xi).
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, eq 1.1.2.1; sign flip recorded in PERIOD-REP-VQUAD-001/fresan-jossen-axioms.md section 2.3.

claim: Gamma-motive M_n = H^1(A^1, x^n): periods Gamma(j/n); Lang structure 0->mu_n->G_{M_n}->S_{Q(mu_n)}->0 with dim G_{M_n} = 1 + phi(n)/2.
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, Ex. 1.1.4; Intro section 1.3.3-1.3.4.

claim: Bessel motive: X=G_m, f=(z/2)(x-1/x), rank-2 connection with regular point at 0 and irregular Poincare-rank-1 point at infinity; periods J_n, H_n. RIGID (no accessory modulus).
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, Ex. 1.1.5.

claim: Lindemann-Weierstrass is an instance of the exponential period conjecture.
source: Fresan-Jossen, Exponential Motives, section 12.1.
